SBI Assistant Manager Engineer (Fire) Recruitment 2026

Basic Information
Organisation: State Bank of India
Post Name: Assistant Manager - Engineer (Fire)
Notification Number: CRPD/SCO/2026-27/29

Important Dates
Online Application Starts: 4 Nov 2026
Last Date to Apply: 25 Nov 2026
Fee Payment Deadline: 25 Nov 2026

Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: 17 (SC-2, ST-2 [including 1 backlog], OBC-1, EWS-1, UR-11)
| Post | SC | ST | OBC | EWS | UR | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Assistant Manager - Engineer (Fire) | 2 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 11 | 17 |

Eligibility and Age
Qualification: B.E. (Fire) from NFSC Nagpur OR B.E./B.Tech (Safety & Fire Engineering) OR B.E./B.Tech (Fire Technology & Safety Engineering) OR an equivalent 4-year Fire Safety degree from a UGC-recognized university or AICTE-approved institution OR Graduate Member of Institution of Fire Engineers (India/UK) OR Divisional Officers Course from NFSC Nagpur.
Work Experience: Minimum 2 years of composite experience in fire safety in a reputed organization for eligible engineering degree holders; OR minimum 3 years as Station Officer or equivalent in a city or state fire brigade, in-charge fire officer in a corporate or large industrial complex, or fire officer in a state government institution or PSU for eligible IFE members or NFSC Divisional Officers Course holders.
Age Limit: Minimum 21 years, Maximum 40 years as on 31 Oct 2026

Fees and Pay
Application Fee: General/EWS/OBC Rs. 750, SC/ST Nil
Pay Scale: Rs. 48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920 (JMGS-I)

Selection Process
Online Written Test:
English Language: 50 Questions, 50 Marks
Professional Knowledge: 75 Questions, 75 Marks
Total: 125 Questions, 125 Marks, 120 Minutes
No penalty for wrong answers (no negative marking)
Interview:
Merit List:
Written test score normalized to 70 marks; interview score normalized to 30 marks; combined merit total 100 marks.

How to Apply
1. Open the SBI careers page and locate advertisement CRPD/SCO/2026-27/29.
2. Read the recruitment advertisement and confirm eligibility and required experience.
3. Register through the linked online application portal with an active email address.
4. Complete the application and upload the prescribed photograph, signature, thumb impression and supporting documents.
5. Review the completed application and pay the applicable fee online.
6. Retain the generated registration details, e-receipt and submitted application form.

Other Details
Documents Required: Recent photograph; signature; thumb impression; brief resume; ID and date-of-birth proof; relevant caste certificate if applicable; educational certificates; experience certificates; Form-16 or offer letter or recent salary slip; NOC if applicable; handwritten declaration.
Job Location: Anywhere in India.
Grade/Scale: Junior Management Grade Scale I (JMGS-I).
Probation Period: 6 months.
Job Role: Improve fire safety at SBI branches and offices; perform fire safety inspections and audits; organize drills and staff training; review fire protection arrangements and liaise with fire service and government authorities.
OBC Candidates: Non-creamy layer certificate with the prescribed clause, issued from 1 Apr 2026 to the interview date.
EWS Candidates: Income and Asset Certificate based on financial year 2025-26, valid for 2026-27, as prescribed in the advertisement.
